name: attract-night
title: Velia: under the Milky Way
about: , 2026-11-07, on sse-2230: "This view is stunning. How can we make users see it?"): the reel's middle shot. The mouth of Emerald Bay at 22:30 on 4 July, a clear moonless night: the camera low on the sill looking south-south-east, the galactic core 19° up over the ridge south of the mouth, Halcyon small in the lower third on a beam reach in light air, lit softly by the starlit night with her nav lights, a faint reflection on the calm water. A slow push of 8 m over 7 s.
